info.name: Macro Markets Public Market Data
info.description: Read-only GraphQL examples for the existing Macro Markets public API. No API_TOKEN, Authorization value, private account data or mutations are included. This file is not proof of marketplace publication.

body.raw: {"query":"query PublicMarketData { marketsPredictions(first: 5, page: 1, language: \"en\") { data { id title slug currency_code status } paginatorInfo { total currentPage } } marketPredictionCategories(first: 10, language: \"en\", enabled: true) { data { id name slug } } }"}

request.description: One actual GraphQL POST endpoint returning public markets and categories. Combining these reads prevents importers from overwriting separate examples with the same method/path. No Macro account token or financial action. Results and market availability change over time.
